$schema-note: Brand colour tokens. Source of truth for the website: app/globals.css in the landing-page repo.

ink.role: Primary text and the dark full-bleed sections.

ink-soft.role: Dark grey surface: cards and panels on ink.

muted.role: Secondary text and captions, on dark surfaces only (5.5:1 on ink).

muted-strong.role: Secondary text on the off-white base (5.7:1). Added because muted only reaches 3.1:1 on off-white.

accent.role: The signature warm amber. The one loud colour: highlights, the mark, key words, buttons, blobs, the 3D hero object.

accent-deep.role: Orange variant for hover/active states, depth and gradients (amber to deep amber, 135 degrees).

gradients.note: Used on the blob shapes. Radial variant on the 3D object: highlight at 35% 30%.

contrast.use: amber text, numbers and marks on dark: OK
ink text and numbers on an amber fill: OK
OK for large text and graphics
stat numerals on dark cards: OK
FAILS for small text. Do not use muted on off-white.
FAILS. Never put amber text or thin amber lines on off-white.
Do not separate shapes by these two alone: too close.

rules: Amber is text only on ink (or ink-soft). On light surfaces amber is a fill, with ink on top.
Light theme with full-bleed ink sections for rhythm. No other background colours.
Amber is used sparingly. Guideline for liveries: about 70-80% off-white/ink, up to roughly 20% amber, deep amber a few percent at most.
Do not introduce new hues. Greys are limited to ink-soft, muted and muted-strong.
